title: 「If + Were _ Past Tense」完全假設句
titleEn: Using the second conditional for unreal or unlikely situations

formula: If + subject + were / past tense, subject + would / could / might + base verb

formulas.formula: If + subject + were / past tense, subject + would / could / might + base verb
Subject + would / could / might + base verb + if + subject + were / past tense

examples.zh: 如果我是校長，我會設立一間安靜的自修室。
examples.highlight: If I were the school principal

rules.zh: 過去式不一定表示過去 在這個句型中，過去式用來表示情況並非目前的事實，或未來發生的機會不大。 這句談的是想像中的現在或未來，而不是過去。
rules.en: The past form here does not necessarily refer to past time. It signals that the situation is not a present fact or is unlikely in the future; the example imagines a present or future situation rather than describing the past.
examples: If I won the lottery, I would travel around the world.

rules.zh: Be 動詞通常使用 were 在標準的完全假設句中，I、he、she、it 等主語後面都使用 were。 本練習不使用 If I was you。
rules.en: Use were with be in the standard fully hypothetical form after I, he, she, it and other subjects. This lesson does not use If I was you.
Do not use would in the if-clause.
examples: If I had more time, I would exercise every day.

rules.zh: 結果部分可以使用 would、could 或 might Would 表示在該假設下會出現的結果。 Could 表示能力或機會。 Might 表示可能性，但並不肯定。
rules.en: Use would, could or might in the result clause. Would gives the expected result under the imagined condition, could expresses ability or opportunity, and might expresses an uncertain possibility.

rules.zh: 注意逗號的位置 If 子句放在前面時，兩部分之間需要逗號。 If 子句放在後面時，通常不需要逗號。
rules.en: Use a comma when the if-clause comes first; when it follows the result clause, no comma is normally needed.

rules.zh: 不要與其他條件句混淆 真實或有可能發生： 完全假設或可能性較低： 與過去事實相反： 本課只練習第二種句型。
rules.en: Do not confuse this unreal conditional with other conditional patterns. A present-form if-clause describes a real or possible condition, the past-form second conditional describes a wholly imagined or less likely situation, and if + past perfect describes a condition contrary to past fact. This lesson practises only the second pattern.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能立即讓聽者知道，你正在想像另一種情況，而不是描述目前的事實。
benefits.en: It clearly separates facts from imagination. This structure tells the listener immediately that you are imagining a different situation rather than describing a real fact.

benefits.zh: 你可以清楚說明：如果某個條件有所改變，可能會出現甚麼不同結果。 第二句把「假設條件」和「可能結果」直接連接起來，兩者的關係更加清楚。
benefits.en: It connects an imagined condition with its result. You can clearly explain how changing one condition might produce a different result, and the conditional version links the imagined condition directly to the possible consequence.

benefits.zh: 你可以使用這個句型談論夢想、不太可能出現的情況、想像中的決定，以及可以如何改善問題。
benefits.en: It helps you discuss dreams and possible solutions. You can use this structure to talk about dreams, unlikely possibilities, imaginary decisions and possible improvements.

benefits.zh: 使用 If I were you, I would... 提出建議，通常比直接命令對方更加婉轉。
benefits.en: It provides a polite way to give advice. If I were you, I would ... is usually gentler than directly telling someone what to do.

benefits.zh: 這個句型適合用於對話、作文、討論和簡報，因為它能幫助你分析不同可能性，而不只是描述目 前的情況。
benefits.en: It helps you develop deeper answers. This structure is useful in conversations, essays, discussions and presentations because it helps you explore possibilities instead of describing only existing facts.

questions.promptZh: 停電時，用戶會失去工作內容，因為軟件不會自動儲存每項變更。
questions.answer: If the software automatically saved each change, users would not lose their work during a power cut.
questions.answerZh: 如果軟件自動儲存每項變更，用戶便不會在停電時失去工作內容。
questions.highlight: If the software automatically saved each change, users would not lose their work during a power cut.

questions.prompt: Interactive exhibitions about local history could help the museum attract more young visitors.
questions.promptZh: 有關本地歷史的互動展覽，可以幫助博物館吸引更多年輕訪客。
questions.answer: The museum could attract more young visitors if it created interactive exhibitions about local history.
questions.answerZh: 如果博物館製作有關本地歷史的互動展覽，便可以吸引更多年輕訪客。
questions.highlight: The museum could attract more young visitors if it created interactive exhibitions about local history.

questions.prompt: You are responsible for the event. In your position, I would provide clear signs so that guests could find every room easily.

questions.prompt: More people using public transport instead of driving short distances would make our city healthier and quieter.
questions.promptZh: 更多人乘搭公共交通而不是短途駕車，會令我們的城市更健康、更寧靜。
questions.answer: Our city would be healthier and quieter if more people used public transport instead of driving short distances.
